profile.Name: Ruka
profile.Job: Former Shek warrior, now a servant
profile.Personality: Brave, proud, and touchy about her missing horns. She holds that a warrior should die with honor and is eager to prove her worth in battle.
profile.Backstory: She woke alive among the dead after a battle she should have died in. Her people called her a deserter, cut off her horns, and made her a servant, and she will not stay in the Shek lands as an unhorned warrior.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Terse and proud. She calls the player "flatskin", opens with "Looking at my horns?", and answers in clipped words like "Truth" and "Insult."
